test_title: PYST 46: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight friends Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ramu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Vivek is second to the right of Anil. Kamal is third to the left of Anil. Ramu is second to the right of Vivek. Ram is second to the right of Ramu. Aakash is second to the right of Rahul. Rahul is not the immediate neighbour of Vivek. Who is third to the right of Aakash?
solution:
Eight friends Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ramu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1) Vivek is second to the right of Anil and Ramu is second to the right of Vivek.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/137c59fe776e450dd03b8f3ed7cefbc462342216697b3c7ceb5feeb73f475940.png] 

2) Ram is second to the right of Ramu and Kamal is third to the left of Anil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5a9708afa7b7d067ad12e703856e7546b2ade3050dd32b6fa4ac43b932f34dc.png] 

3) Aakash is second to the right of Rahul and Rahul is not the immediate neighbour of Vivek.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bf03503fc43a7e57f595ecae50e33d58bdfbc3503d15ce6bc824d58fb20897e.png] 

∴ Here, 'Ramu' is third to the right of Aakash.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Ramu".**
